name: FurDU
blurb: Australia's largest furry convention, a beachside weekend of fursuiting, art and performances at Surfers Paradise on the Gold Coast.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown 'COUNTDOWN TO FURDU 2027' and banner 'FurDU Presents: Enchanted Forest. April 16-18 2027', plus 'See you at Crowne Plaza Surfers Paradise on the 16th of April!'.

notes: Homepage art only shows the mascots (DuRoo, Sheila) as forest fairies for the 'Enchanted Forest' theme, no guest-of-honour names; a web search confirms FurDU 2027's guest(s) of honour have not been announced yet. No ticket/registration link distinct from the general site was found. Organizer written on-site as 'Furry Down Under' (copyright line and acknowledgement-of-country text); the legal entity is 'Furry Down Under Inc.' per the trademark line, but the plain trading name is used here to match the site's own usage.
